language.title: Language

appearance.title: Appearance

mcp.title: MCP access
mcp.intro: Connect an MCP client such as Claude Code, Claude Desktop or Cursor to this workspace. The client acts as you: it sees only what you can see, and a read-write token can do what the workspace assistant can — read records, create and update tasks, post status updates and draft knowledge notes. It cannot delete anything, change membership, ship releases or publish notes.
mcp.unavailable: MCP access is not configured on this deployment yet. An administrator needs to set INSFORGE_API_KEY and INSFORGE_JWT_SECRET.
mcp.name: Token name
mcp.scopeHint: Prefer read only unless the client needs to make changes. Each token is shown once; revoke it here if it is lost or no longer needed.
mcp.createdOnce: Copy this token now. It will not be shown again.
